questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT an acceptable ground for denying admission to a child under the RTE Act?
options_english: The child does not possess a valid birth certificate.
The child seeks admission beyond the extended period and has no valid reason.
The school has already filled its sanctioned maximum capacity per fire and safety norms.

questions.explanation_english: Section 14(2) explicitly mandates that no child shall be denied admission to a school for lack of age proof or birth certificate. key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) The child does not possess a valid birth certificate.

Denying admission on this ground is strictly illegal, whereas reaching maximum safety capacity or seeking entry in specialized non-minority quotas involve valid administrative considerations.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following provisions related to Kendriya Vidyalayas (Specified Category Schools) under the RTE Act:
I. They are required to admit 25% students from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups in Class 1.
II. They are entirely exempt from the RTE Act.
III. They do not need a separate certificate of recognition as they are established by the Central Government.
IV. They are bound by the no-screening procedure and no-capitation fee rules. Which of the above are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV
I, III and IV
II and III
III and IV
questions.explanation_english: As Specified Category schools, Kendriya Vidyalayas must reserve 25% entry seats for EWS/DG students under Section 12(1)(c) and adhere to prohibitions on screening and capitation fees. Being established by the Central Government, they do not require separate recognition certificates under Section 18.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, III और IV है। निर्दिष्ट श्रेणी के विद्यालय भी RTE अधिनियम के लागू प्रावधानों के अधीन होते हैं, जिनमें प्रवेश-स्तर पर पात्र बच्चों के लिए 25% प्रावधान और स्क्रीनिंग/कैपिटेशन फीस पर रोक शामिल है। केंद्र सरकार द्वारा स्थापित विद्यालयों के लिए मान्यता संबंधी अलग व्यवस्था हो सकती है; इसका अर्थ अधिनियम से पूर्ण छूट नहीं है। इसलिए कथन II गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, III and IV

As Specified Category schools, Kendriya Vidyalayas must reserve 25% entry seats for EWS/DG students under Section 12(1)(c) and adhere to prohibitions on screening and capitation fees. Being established by the Central Government, they do not require separate recognition certificates under Section 18.
